description: Belgian consumer news for people who want to save (dealio.be/nieuws/): prices, promotions, store openings and incidents, product recalls (FAVV), tests (Test-Aankoop), taxes and energy, summarised by dealio in two or three sentences with our own headline, the source and the link to its article, newest first. Filter by store (name or slug) or theme. Each item has dealio's link (the item on the news page) and the store pages it names.

offset.description: Skip this many items (for the next page).

q.description: Words to find in the headline or summary (Dutch). Optional.

store.description: Only news that names this store, by name or slug, e.g. 'Delhaize', 'aldi'. Optional.

name: get_news
